---
title: "Usage"
execute:
  warning: false
  message: false
---

Repository usage for this registry, archived weekly. GitHub keeps only 14 days of traffic, so the history here comes from the `stats-data` branch. Views and clones come from GitHub's traffic API; repository owners' own visits are included, and counts are indicative rather than exact.

```{r}
#| include: false
library(ggplot2)

# Prefer a local checkout of the archive; otherwise read the published branch
archive_url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/forest-carbon-tools-dfs/CanGrowthModels/stats-data/"

read_usage <- function(name) {
  local <- file.path("usage-data", name)
  source_path <- if (file.exists(local)) local else paste0(archive_url, name)
  tryCatch(
    readr::read_csv(source_path, show_col_types = FALSE, progress = FALSE),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
}

# Line chart of one or more series over time, or a note when there is no data yet
plot_usage <- function(data, series, ylab) {
  if (is.null(data) || nrow(data) == 0) {
    return(cat("*No data archived yet.*\n"))
  }
  long <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(series), function(column) {
    data.frame(date = as.Date(data$date), series = series[[column]], value = data[[column]])
  }))
  print(
    ggplot(long, aes(date, value, colour = series)) +
      geom_line() +
      geom_point(size = 1) +
      labs(x = NULL, y = ylab, colour = NULL) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  )
}
```

## Page views

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
plot_usage(read_usage("traffic_views.csv"), c(count = "Views", uniques = "Unique visitors"), "Per day")
```

## Clones

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
plot_usage(read_usage("traffic_clones.csv"), c(count = "Clones", uniques = "Unique cloners"), "Per day")
```

## Stars, forks and watchers

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
plot_usage(read_usage("repo_snapshot.csv"), c(stars = "Stars", forks = "Forks", watchers = "Watchers"), "Total")
```

## Release downloads

Counts uploaded release assets only; GitHub does not count source archives.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
downloads <- read_usage("release_downloads.csv")
if (is.null(downloads) || nrow(downloads) == 0) {
  cat("*No release assets yet.*\n")
} else {
  latest <- downloads[downloads$date == max(downloads$date), c("tag", "asset", "downloads")]
  print(knitr::kable(latest))
}
```
